protocol.whiteboard_rule: 모든 서브에이전트는 작업 시작 전 .claude/whiteboard.json 을 읽고, 종료 전 반드시 .claude/wb/<ROLE>.json 에 자신의 상태(Status: Waiting|In Progress|Done)와 산출물 경로를 기록한다. 규칙을 어기고 종료 금지.
protocol.parallel_write_note: JSON 손상 방지: 병렬 에이전트는 공유 whiteboard.json 을 직접 쓰지 않고 각자 .claude/wb/<ROLE>.json 에 기록. PM 이 단일 writer 로 병합해 whiteboard.json 갱신.
protocol.unity_constraint: Unity batchmode 는 단일 배타 자원 → 빌드/검증(QA)만 직렬. 코드/에셋/사운드 제작은 병렬.

roles.PM: 전체 일정 관리 및 task.json 발행, whiteboard 병합, commit/close
roles.Director: 핵심 기획 및 아트/사운드 최종 승인 (feel/tone)

roles.QA: 버그 리포트 + 프로그램 검증 (Unity 빌드/하니스 - 단일 배타)
roles.AIDesigner: FSM/BT 등 AI 로직 설계 + 경로탐색 안전 제약

wave.lane_contract: STRICT file isolation. At most ONE lane (A) may touch a SceneSetup hot file this wave, and even A should aim for ZERO (Deconstruct in W-M4-01 self-attached for zero budget — Mine should do the same). Lane A (MINE DESIGNATION, #16) owns: NEW Assets/Scripts/MineDesignation.cs (a self-bootstrapping designation+input-mode manager mirroring the just-shipped DeconstructDesignation.cs EXACTLY — [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)], hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO, FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard, read-only poll-find of managers/StoneVeinEntities, Time.unscaledTime deltas not WaitForSeconds, AudioBank read-only on click) that lets the player enter a 'mine mode' and drag-rect or click rock/ore cells to designate StoneVeinEntities; PLUS the mine ACTION on the existing miner/builder class (PREFER a dedicated PawnMiner.cs if one exists since mining is conceptually separate from construction; ONLY fall back to PawnBuilder.cs if there is no miner class — reuse the deconstruct/build stand-cell + WorkGiveUp + DistanceToFootprint pathing wholesale, introduce NO new pathfinding) that dispatches an idle pawn to walk to a designated vein and call the EXISTING StoneVeinEntity.TakeMineDamage until depleted (yield/chunk-drop already exists in StoneVeinEntity); Lane A may touch StoneVeinEntity.cs ONLY if a tiny designation-aware hook is genuinely needed (prefer leaving it untouched). Lane A does NOT touch SaveLoadManager.cs, any test .cs/asmdef, TreeEntity.cs, AudioBank.cs (read-only call only), TreeSwayDriver, or any other lane's files; route the mode toggle through a self-attached Canvas button like DeconstructDesignation did (ZERO SceneSetup budget); if a SceneSetup edit is truly unavoidable it must be the ONLY hot-file touch in the wave and be FLAGGED. Lane B (SAVE-LOAD SERIALIZATION FIX, #29 — the QA-flagged follow-up) owns: SaveLoadManager.cs ONLY — extend SaveData with BedSave/StockpileSave/WallSave lists + add a species field to TreeSave, write each entity's sub-state from its EXISTING public getters (BedEntity quality, StockpileZone priority, WallEntity material, TreeEntity species) on Save, re-apply on Load. If an entity exposes NO public setter to re-apply on load, do NOT widen the lane into entity files — skip that one field on Load, document it, and FLAG that specific entity for a tiny follow-up setter add (keep ALL edits inside SaveLoadManager.cs). Lane B does NOT edit any test .cs (the existing V9SaveLoadRoundTripTest should now flip to PASS without editing it; if its expected-FAIL assertions must be inverted, FLAG for QA rather than editing the test in this code lane), MineDesignation/PawnMiner/PawnBuilder, TreeSwayDriver, or any SceneSetup. Lane C (TREE-SWAY, V5 remainder) owns: NEW Assets/Scripts/TreeSwayDriver.cs ONLY, self-attaching via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] exactly like FlickerLight.cs / RainSoundDriver.cs / NightLightPoolDriver.cs (hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO, FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard). It finds TreeEntity sprite-children READ-ONLY and applies a very-subtle +/-1px-equivalent (~0.03-0.05 world units) horizontal sine sway (~0.3 Hz) to the SPRITE CHILD transform ONLY (never the root — root is read by pathfinding/scatter clustering/contact-shadow/save position), eased, deterministic per-tree phase offset. It MUST NOT edit TreeEntity.cs, FlickerLight.cs, _gen_sprites.py, any SceneSetup/prefab/entity, SaveLoadManager.cs, MineDesignation/miner, or any other lane's files. Lane D (V8 OBSTACLE-PATHFIND VERIFY) owns: NEW test .cs under the EXISTING PlayMode/EditMode test asmdef (same asmdef as V4CombatChainTest/V5FoodChainTest/V7RaidThreatTest/V8MoveSpeedTest/V9SaveLoadRoundTripTest; do NOT edit any existing test or runtime .cs) asserting as ONE binary PASS the V8 slate item: a pawn whose straight-line path is blocked by a wall/obstacle either STOPS or PATHFINDS AROUND it (reaches a reachable target by routing around the blocker; never occupies/clips the blocked cell; does not get stuck off-grid). Reuse the prior tests' bootstrap + PathGrid/PawnMovement read-only conventions; if PathGrid lacks a needed read-only accessor, FLAG it rather than editing runtime. Lane D touches NO runtime .cs and NO other test file. Cross-lane proof: A=MineDesignation.cs(new)+PawnMiner-or-PawnBuilder.cs(+StoneVeinEntity.cs only-if-needed); B=SaveLoadManager.cs; C=TreeSwayDriver.cs(new); D=new test .cs. No file appears in two lanes. A's miner file is touched by NO other lane; B's SaveLoadManager.cs by NO other lane; C and D are each a single new file. Only Lane A may (but should NOT) touch a SceneSetup hot file; B/C/D touch zero SceneSetup.
